tagline.en: I build web applications made to work in the real world, from understanding the need to shipping the product.

bio.fr:
Je conçois et développe des applications web complètes avec Laravel et Vue.js : outils métier, plateformes, sites connectés à une application. J’interviens de l’analyse du besoin jusqu’à la mise en ligne, avec une attention particulière à la qualité du code, à l’expérience utilisateur et au référencement.
Depuis octobre 2024, je travaille chez Megatech SARL à Cotonou, où je participe à l’analyse et au développement d’applications comme Wura, Forbmit, CISTE ou Présentia.
bio.en:
I design and build complete web applications with Laravel and Vue.js: business tools, platforms, websites connected to an app. I work from understanding the need through to launch, with close attention to code quality, user experience and search visibility.
Since October 2024 I have been working at Megatech SARL in Cotonou, contributing to the analysis and development of applications such as Wura, Forbmit, CISTE and Présentia.

This page explains what data this site collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

Data controller

This site is published by {name}, a fullstack developer based in Cotonou (Benin). For any question about your data, write to {email}.

Data collected

  • Contact form and service requests: name, email address, phone number (optional), subject, message and site language.
  • Newsletter: email address and language.
  • Audience measurement: page viewed, referring site, device type and a random visit identifier. No IP address is stored and no tracking cookie is set.

Purposes

  • Replying to your messages and service requests.
  • Sending you the newsletter, if you subscribed.
  • Understanding anonymously which pages are viewed, in order to improve the site.

Retention

Messages are kept for as long as needed to follow up on your request, then deleted. Newsletter addresses are kept until you unsubscribe. A deleted item stays in the administration trash for 30 days before being permanently erased.

Recipients

Your data is only accessible to the site owner. It is never sold, rented or transferred. The hosting provider and the email delivery service process it only to keep the site running.

Cookies

The site only uses technical cookies required for it to work (session and form protection). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

Your rights

You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, object to its processing or unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time by writing to {email}. You can also lodge a complaint with Benin's personal data protection authority (APDP) or with the authority in your country.

Changes

This policy may change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

body.fr:
Un cookie est un petit fichier déposé par un site sur votre appareil. Ce site en utilise très peu, et aucun à des fins publicitaires.

Cookies utilisés

  • Cookie de session : permet au site de fonctionner d'une page à l'autre. Supprimé à la fermeture du navigateur ou après deux heures d'inactivité.
  • Jeton de sécurité (XSRF-TOKEN) : protège les formulaires contre les envois frauduleux.

Ces cookies sont strictement nécessaires : ils ne demandent pas votre consentement et ne servent pas à vous suivre.

Stockage dans le navigateur

  • Langue préférée (fz.lang) : retient si vous lisez le site en français ou en anglais.
  • Identifiant de visite (fz.sid) : numéro aléatoire qui permet de compter les visites sans vous identifier. Il est effacé à la fermeture de l'onglet.

Aucun traceur tiers

Le site n'utilise ni Google Analytics, ni pixel publicitaire, ni bouton de partage qui dépose des cookies. Les liens vers les réseaux sociaux sont de simples liens.

Gérer les cookies

Vous pouvez supprimer ou bloquer les cookies dans les réglages de votre navigateur. Bloquer le cookie de session peut empêcher l'envoi des formulaires.

Pour toute question : {email}.
body.en:
A cookie is a small file that a website stores on your device. This site uses very few, and none for advertising.

Cookies used

  • Session cookie: lets the site work from one page to the next. Deleted when you close the browser or after two hours of inactivity.
  • Security token (XSRF-TOKEN): protects the forms against fraudulent submissions.

These cookies are strictly necessary: they do not require your consent and are not used to track you.

Browser storage

  • Preferred language (fz.lang): remembers whether you read the site in French or English.
  • Visit identifier (fz.sid): a random number used to count visits without identifying you. It is erased when you close the tab.

No third-party trackers

The site uses no Google Analytics, no advertising pixel and no share button that sets cookies. Links to social networks are plain links.

Managing cookies

You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking the session cookie may prevent the forms from being sent.

For any question: {email}.
